name: dsh-link-bridge
description: Wake a DSH conversation automatically when dsh-link messages arrive (one Session per topic, retired sessions archived), deliver a peer's message into the exact Session it names (directed conversations), serve the peer capability channel: list/read/create/prompt/rename/archive conversations on this machine on request, and render this machine's hub uplink state — plus a manual reconnect — in the DSH Settings → dsh-link panel.
